materials_exhausted.note: Opened packet manifest/locators, XML/PDF text, OA package files, supplementary ZIP/PDF text, linked APD6/DBAASP JSONL snapshots, merged sequence catalog, and final artifacts. Remaining database conflicts are preserved cautions, not blocking missing material.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/6 closeout for As-CATH8 paper: peptide identities and most DBAASP assay rows reconcile to primary Tables 1-3 and Supplementary Tables S4-S5; final activity and mechanism artifacts were rebuilt from local source evidence; residual database-only/citation/strain issues are preserved as cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 verified source-supported sequences and MIC/MBIC rows; 30 linked rows remain source_conflict because local source does not support exact database cytotoxicity bins, KPLN649/USA300 target labels, or malformed APD6 raw citation fields.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-6 rebuilt final activity/toxicity evidence from primary XML tables and supplementary PDF tables, preserving µM and µg/mL values and adding source-supported qualitative toxicity, organoid, abscess, and time-kill claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced pending-review mechanism notes with direct-assay mechanism claims for membrane depolarization/permeabilization and DNA binding, plus clearly bounded activity-kinetic and inferred multi-target claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_layer: The prior rework ticket is closed because source-reviewed adjudication is complete; cautions remain visible without blocking publication-grade acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP percent-cytotoxicity rows are compatible with Figure S3 trends, but exact binned percentages are not tabulated in local XML/PDF text; preserved as source_conflict.
DBAASP has K. pneumoniae KPLN649 and one S. aureus USA300 MIC row; local Methods/Table 2 support KPLN49 and the table S. aureus row is not assignable to USA300.
APD6 entry-text rows have malformed raw pubmed_id/reference fields, while linked literature rows and article metadata support DOI 10.3390/antibiotics11111603 and PMID 36421248.
